world_org_meetings.title: UK and Germany will face threats together, says Burnham in Berlin
world_org_meetings.description: Ahead of a UK-EU summit next month, Burnham said he was committed to "see if we can bring the UK closer to Europe".

world_org_meetings.title: The G7 will release 100 million reserve barrels of diesel fuel over the next 4 months
world_org_meetings.description: After increased pressure from Washington, the G7 held an emergency meeting on energy. The world's wealthiest nations say they will release 100 million barrels of oil and diesel fuel in their reserves.

world_org_meetings.title: G20 trade ministers are meeting in Wisconsin. Many will be discussing deals without their U.S. host
world_org_meetings.description: Most of the officials attending the G20 trade ministers' meeting in Milwaukee, Wisc., find themselves in challenging positions, largely because of U.S. President Donald Trump's global tariff agenda. It makes for a potentially unusual summit, with high-level meetings on the sidelines where different countries discuss plans to work around the host.

world_org_meetings.title: Trump’s tariffs loom over talks as G20 meets in US
world_org_meetings.description: Trade ministers of the Group of 20 are meeting in Milwaukee for two days of talks on Wednesday, but US President Donald Trump’s tariffs are expected to hang heavy over the talks. "Don't expect any breakthroughs," an analyst watching the event said.

world_org_meetings.title: Nato welcomes Greenland deal as Trump says it will give US 'permanent security control'
world_org_meetings.description: Denmark and the US have reached an agreement after months of threats from Donald Trump to annex the territory.

diplomatic_visits.title: Citroën bets on nostalgia at Paris motor show amis struggling French sales
diplomatic_visits.description: French president Emmanuel Macron is paying his customary visit to the Paris Motor Show this morning. This year's show sees electric and hybrid vehicles in the spotlight as European carbuilders seek to roll back years of sliding sales. The sector has been given a boost by China's commitment to stem the flow of Chinese e-vehicles, and some builders, such as the multinational Stellantis are betting on small affordable electric cars to win back customers. And one of the models it has lined up is an electric reboot of a French classic: the Citroën 2CV. FRANCE 24’s Charles Pellegrin interviewed Citroen CEO Xavier Chardon.

diplomatic_visits.title: Ceuta or Sebta? Why one city has two names and a disputed status
diplomatic_visits.description: Felipe VI’s first visit to Ceuta and Melilla as king brings Spain’s territorial dispute with Morocco back into focus.

diplomatic_visits.title: Trump says Ukraine needs new president who will agree to end war
diplomatic_visits.description: US President Donald Trump on Saturday urged Ukraine to replace Volodymyr Zelensky with a new leader, criticising him over strikes on Russian oil refineries that have contributed to high diesel prices ahead of the US midterm elections. Trump told reporters at the White House that he had told Zelensky to "do what you want" against Russia, but "don't hit refineries". "He better damn well stop," Trump said, adding that he believes "it's time for Ukraine to get a new president" who would agree to end the war. We discuss the latest developments with our guest, Pyotr Kurzin, host of The Global Gambit.

diplomatic_visits.title: Manny Pacquiao hosts Polish president Karol Nawrocki for Manila boxing workout
diplomatic_visits.description: Polish President Karol Nawrocki trains in Manila with boxing legend Manny Pacquiao, who now leads the Philippines’ National Anti-Poverty Commission.

diplomatic_visits.title: Rubio visits Portugal, praising a 'great ally' and looking to build deeper ties
diplomatic_visits.description: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio is in Portugal, wrapping up a tour of NATO allies

elections.title: Sinn Féin ministers facing no-confidence vote after Drumcree dispute
elections.description: The motion against Michelle O'Neill and three other Sinn Féin ministers will be debated after receiving the backing of unionist parties last week.

elections.title: How the ICE surge in Minnesota could impact the midterms
elections.description: Operation Metro Surge is still a "fresh wound" in Minnesota, where a sweeping immigration crackdown saw thousands of arrested and two U.S. citizens killed. Minnesotans organized grassroots opposition against the federal officers. Now many of those same people have signed up for training to protect the polls in a Senate race that could be pivotal.

elections.title: Who is Raphael Glucksmann, winner of the French left presidential primary?
elections.description: With just six months to go to presidential polls in France, a coalition of centre left parties have chosen their candidate… It's EU lawmaker, Raphael Glucksmann. The 46 year old tells voters he stands for a break with Macronism, a break with the far left of candidate Jean Luc Melenchon and that he's the candidate who can defeat the far right… though opinion polls suggest that in a second round run off he would not beat far right candidate Marine Le Pen.

elections.title: Left-wing candidate Hitler Mussolini wins local vote in Peru
elections.description: Hitler Mussolini Simeón Flores won by 25 votes in Queropalca, a district of just over 730 people in the Huánuco department, running for the centre-left Ahora Nación party. He is not Peru’s first elected Hitler.

elections.title: Far right surges as crises threaten Sanchez: Could Vox lead Spain?
elections.description: Snap vote could bring PP, Vox to power as polls show falling support for Sanchez, one of Europe's last leftist leaders.
